faqs.question: Is bat removal in New Jersey regulated?
faqs.answer: Yes, bat removal in New Jersey is regulated by state wildlife laws. Bats are protected species and can only be excluded during specific times of year (typically outside of maternity season from May to August). Our team of licensed or supervised professionals ensure all works complies with NJ Department of Environmental Protection regulations.

faqs.question: How do I know if I have bats in my Harrison home?
faqs.answer: Common signs include squeaking or scratching sounds at dusk or dawn, droppings (guano) in attics or near entry points, brown staining around small openings, and seeing bats entering or exiting your home at sunset. If you notice any of these signs in your Harrison property, contact us for a professional inspection.

faqs.question: What does the bat exclusion process involve?
faqs.answer: The process typically takes 2-4 weeks to complete. Every service includes a service agreement — terms depend on the service and are confirmed on the call.
